MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 5
   D. 13

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 48

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 31
   D. 43

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 4
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 13 − 9
3. x = 4
Final Answer: x = 4
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²

2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 6
3. Product = 48
Final Answer: 48

Working:

Final Answer: 41 cm
